decision.rationale: I recommend a provisional credit of 42.92 EUR, the difference between the posted amount and the receipt. The dispute is in time: TXN-007991 posted on 2026-08-15 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-27, which is 73 days later, within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The posting at Harbour Market (MER-000064) is 145.12 EUR (14512 minor units). Its authorisation, AUTH-008191, was approved for 102.20 EUR (10220). The merchant's own receipt, DOC-000040, shows a total of 102.20 EUR. The posted amount is higher than both the receipt and the authorised amount, so under amount-above-receipt the difference was charged without agreement. Only that difference is credited, not the whole transaction: 14512 - 10220 = 4292 minor units (42.92 EUR). This matches the cardholder's claim and is well under the 3,000.00 EUR limit in provisional-credit.
